name: SIQ - Trending Countdown Reveal
description: Fullscreen scroll-driven product reveal with countdown timer. Starts with a cinematic hero featuring animated mesh gradient, heading, description, CTA button and a live countdown. As the user scrolls, colourful product title cards appear tilted in the top-right corner, fan out, rotate to horizontal, then separate into a vertical list. Finally the colour cards shrink to reveal full product cards with image, title, price and an arrow link. Up to 5 products, fully pinned during the entire scroll sequence.
author: SectionIQ
